units.source_text: 岛村想起了去年岁末那面映着晨雪的镜子，然后看了看梳妆台那边，

en.t: Shimamura remembered the mirror from the end of last year, the one that had reflected the morning snow, and then looked toward the dressing table,

units.source_text: 只见镜中依然清晰地浮现出冰冷的纷纷扬扬的大雪花，

en.t: he saw that cold, fluttering flakes of heavy snow still stood out clearly in the mirror,

units.source_text: 在敞开衣领揩拭着脖颈的驹子的周围，飘成了一条白线。

en.t: and around Komako, who had opened her collar and was wiping her neck, they drifted into a single white line.
